description.text: In a dark studio, a low platform of polished floor holds the covered shape of the car. The fitted cloth begins to slide from the long nose, gathering in folds along the flank before dropping clear of the bodywork. As the cover falls away, the car is revealed as a black sports car with a carbon fibre body taken from the first picture. The broad front wing and low roofline emerge first; the weave across the panels catches a narrow key light while broader rim light traces the shoulders and door line. The car stays stationary, wheels planted, its surfaces reflecting a restrained strip of cool light and a warmer edge from the rear. The floor carries a faint mirror image of the sill. The last folds of fabric settle beside the platform, and the bodywork is fully exposed, clean and deliberately presented in the quiet studio.
